short_description: Using the musket of Captain Davy Jones, you’ll need to kill as many enemy pirates as possible in order to achieve a high score and earn your title as Pirate Lord of the Seven Seas. Be careful though. Your enemies will grow angrier the more you attack them. Be sure to drink more rum and get stronger.
reviews:
“I really enjoy the music and the entire pirate vibe it gives without being a ship simulator. It's a simple arena-survival roguelike game that captures the imagination and keeps you playing for hours.”
10/10 – JonHogan - Metacritic

“Loved the soundtrack, encountered no bugs, stayed engaged, and liked the old arcade aesthetic. It's a 10/10 for a job well done.”
10/10 – KrollMike87 - Metacritic
